# Dr. Ogunmola's Lab

> The personal lab of Dr. Oluwaseun Ogunmola, an AI consultant and speaker who is a scientist at heart. The lab is where ideas in software, AI, servers and cloud, and games for learning get tested, and where the ones that work come to live.

Dr. Oluwaseun Ogunmola does consulting, talks and AI work (see the main website below). This site, ogunmola.com.ng, is the experimental side: things built to test an idea.

Every build follows the same five-step loop:
1. Notice: spot a real problem that real people have.
2. Hypothesise: make a testable guess about what would help.
3. Build: make the smallest thing that can test the guess.
4. Test: put it in front of the people it's for, and measure.
5. Learn: keep what works, drop what doesn't, go again.

## Builds

- [Dr. Ogunmola GameLabs](https://gamelabs.ogunmola.com.ng/): Free educational games that run in the browser, with no sign-up. First up is MathsBlitz, quick-fire arithmetic from JSS 1 through to WAEC and JAMB revision. The experiment: can short, well-made games make practice something students choose to come back to?

- [AiiA: Artificial Intelligence in Africa](https://aiia.teravest.com.ng/): A pan-African initiative of Teravest Technology Labs helping Africans learn and apply AI, through bootcamps, free courses and e-books, and programmes for schools, women and small businesses. The experiment: can affordable, hands-on AI training put the tools in the hands of every African community, not just the tech hubs?
